units.source_text: 转眼间，由于各山远近高低不同，加深了山峦皱襞不同层次的影子。

en.t: In an instant, as the mountains differed in distance and height, the layered shadows in their folds deepened.

units.source_text: 只有山巅还残留着淡淡的余晖，在顶峰的积雪上抹上一片霞光。

en.t: Only the mountaintops still held a faint afterglow, brushing the snow on the peaks with rosy evening light.
